reason: I'd try the free tier for a pad kra pao, sure, but I already learn Thai dishes from YouTube for free and three free dishes a month covers how often I'd actually cook something new. I don't pay for recipes, and $2.99 is still another monthly subscription I'd forget to cancel.
objection: Nothing here is something I can't already get free from Thai cooks on YouTube; the hands-free voice is nice but I'm not convinced an AI knows real Thai home cooking better than an actual Thai grandma on TikTok.
would_change_my_mind: If the free dishes genuinely tasted like what I ate in Thailand and the voice coaching saved me from screwing up a curry paste mid-cook, I might pay, especially as a one-time or yearly price instead of monthly.
